parts.name: Rotation Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the rotation lid of a cardboard box, made of corrugated cardboard. It is a flat, foldable part attached to the base body by a hinge-like fold.
parts.Functional_description: The lid functions as a cover to protect and enclose the contents of the box. It can be opened or closed by rotating along the fold line.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the hinge line connecting it to the base body, allowing opening and closing motion.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of a cardboard box, made of corrugated cardboard. It forms the main container area that holds the contents.
parts.Functional_description: The base body provides structural support and holds the items placed inside the box. It connects to the lid through a fold line.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the foundation of the box, with no independent movement.
